hypothesis: Frozen MLP boundaries may miss patient-balanced class/subtype geometry. Fit shared-covariance prototype evidence in the existing MLP embedding, then test fixed mixtures with the unchanged original classifier.
fitting: For each original development/outer-CV source head, obtain embeddings using its own train-only feature statistics. Fit all prototype means and pooled covariance only on that head fitting patients; no stopping or outer embeddings enter these statistics. Each patient has equal mass within each target; prototype targets receive equal covariance mass.
priors: Equal probability for the three requested parent classes; within a parent, subtype prior proportional to fitting-patient support.
temperature: Fixed likelihood temperature sqrt(embedding dimension), no validation temperature search.
parameter_control: The MLP and backbone are unchanged; weight0 must exactly reproduce the original classifier. Compare coarse and subtype geometry at identical shrinkage and probability weights.
counting: 48 small generative fits: 4 geometry configurations times12 existing source heads. No new backbone or MLP training.12 composite prediction candidates.
evaluation: Three-seed mean for all candidates, original patient3fold CV with original separate internal stopping patients. Passing validation/CV candidates require a newly fixed repeated-patient confirmation before external evaluation.
external_test_policy: No external predictions, metrics or labels loaded.
